metric: Pairs proved equivalent by the z3 prover over all databases meeting the declared keys and NOT NULL columns, with no LLM. Inequivalent pairs stay out of this count.
correctness: 0 false proofs: every proof survives 1,000 further random DuckDB databases and VeriEQL's published counterexamples replayed on DuckDB
caveats: Full corpus (23,994 pairs). No labels. MySQL source run on DuckDB; 1,072 pairs are not run (DuckDB rejects them, mostly a table name the schema spells differently and GROUP BY positions that name aggregates). Search settings were tuned on a 1,000-pair sample (every 24th pair), so the other pairs are held out from that tuning. The aggregate facts (cluster 19) moved the 1,000-pair sample from 198 to 215 proved; the full corpus was not rerun for them, so the full count is a lower bound until the next full run.
held_out: Search settings tuned on every 24th pair (1,000); the other 22,994 pairs are unseen: 3,233 of the 3,586 pairs VeriEQL refutes are refuted here too (90%).
